name: UNRULY
description: Open-source, offline-first browser drawing and whiteboarding application with pen-first interaction, infinite canvas and local-first data.

attributes.plain_language_summary: A personal cross-device drawing and whiteboarding app intended to feel fluid with a pen, work offline, and remain open source.

name: Browser-first architecture
description: The browser application is the primary implementation direction. Native Windows/Android enhancements or wrappers may follow later; native-only is historical.

name: Offline local-first operation
description: Core drawing and board editing work without a hosted SaaS backend; local storage is authoritative while offline.

name: Google Drive sync
description: Optional authenticated synchronization with conflict preservation; both conflicting revisions are retained for user choice.

attributes.plain_language_summary: Optional authenticated synchronization with conflict preservation; both conflicting revisions are retained for user choice.

name: No required hosted SaaS backend
description: Backend test scope refers to document engine, storage, history and adapters rather than inventing a server/database.

name: Open-source release
description: UNRULY is intended to be open source. License choice remains unresolved.

name: Infinite canvas
description: Infinite pan/zoom workspace with multiple saved boards and finite export/artboard frames when needed.

name: Drawing engine
description: Current preview draws vector strokes with pressure snapshots. Hybrid raster painting is future scope, not verified implemented behavior.

attributes.plain_language_summary: Current preview draws vector strokes with pressure snapshots. Hybrid raster painting is future scope, not verified implemented behavior.

name: Brush system
description: Verified U2 brush system with 12 original deterministic presets across Pencil, Pen, Marker and Airbrush; per-preset size/opacity memory; legacy no-preset strokes retain the historical renderer path. Future watercolour/texture/import directions remain separate.

name: Layer system
description: Verified layers: add above active, top-first order, visibility/locks, opacity and blending. Masks are planned. Clear active layer passed CI1 but repaired hosted update is pending.

attributes.plain_language_summary: Verified layers: add above active, top-first order, visibility/locks, opacity and blending. Masks are planned. Clear active layer passed CI1 but repaired hosted update is pending.

name: Selection and transform
description: Prominent lasso selection with move, copy, cut, paste, delete and explicit transform workflows.

name: Gesture system
description: Procreate-inspired browser-safe gestures for undo/redo, pan/zoom, eyedropper and held-shape workflows.

name: Color system
description: Verified U2 colour system with outer hue ring, inner saturation/value disc, Hex/H/S/V controls, 12 generated shades, recent colours, saved palette and toolbar current-colour indicator.

name: Effects and fill
description: Gaussian blur, HSL-style adjustments and gap-aware raster fill planned with preview/apply/cancel boundaries.

attributes.plain_language_summary: Gaussian blur, HSL-style adjustments and gap-aware raster fill planned with preview/apply/cancel boundaries.

name: Whiteboarding objects
description: Editable text boxes, sticky notes, connectors and reference images in addition to drawing.

attributes.plain_language_summary: Editable text boxes, sticky notes, connectors and reference images in addition to drawing.

name: Timelapse
description: Local deterministic process replay and video export; retention/framing details remain unresolved.

attributes.plain_language_summary: Local deterministic process replay and video export; retention/framing details remain unresolved.

name: Motion Trace
description: Move selected content along paths and audience-view pan/zoom with manual-first playback and optional commit-to-board.

attributes.plain_language_summary: Move selected content along paths and audience-view pan/zoom with manual-first playback and optional commit-to-board.

name: Import/export and exchange
description: Image/PDF-page import, PNG/JPG/PDF export and investigated layered PSD exchange for Procreate/Clip Studio interoperability.

attributes.plain_language_summary: Image/PDF-page import, PNG/JPG/PDF export and investigated layered PSD exchange for Procreate/Clip Studio interoperability.

name: BYOK AI assistance
description: Optional user-controlled AI to summarize/diagram selected ideas and export documents/images after base validation.

attributes.plain_language_summary: Optional user-controlled AI to summarize/diagram selected ideas and export documents/images after base validation.

name: Governed delivery and QA
description: Checkpoint-based delivery with independent QA, Gatekeeper review, regression and resumable evidence.

name: Performance foundation
description: Cached rendering, bounded canvas memory and regression benchmarks to preserve drawing responsiveness.

name: Procreate-inspired UX baseline
description: Selected Procreate Fundamentals layout and current handbook behavior are the UX reference family, without copying proprietary assets/algorithms.

name: Compact icon toolbar
description: Dark compact toolbars with original icons; document/actions/selection/transform left and brush/smudge/eraser/layers/color roles right.

name: Independent left size/opacity rail
description: Narrow size/opacity/undo-redo rail that collapses independently from Layers.

name: Compact layers popover
description: Topmost-first compact layers UI with add above active, drag reorder, swipe actions and independent collapse.

name: Brush library popover
description: Implemented and QA-verified two-column Brush Library: brush families on the left, renderer-backed preset previews on the right, per-preset size/opacity memory and reset defaults.

name: Hue disc color picker
description: Implemented and QA-verified hue ring plus inner saturation/value disc, generated shade row, recent colours, saved palette and precise Hex/H/S/V controls.

name: Pen-first interaction

name: Two-finger single tap Undo

name: Three-finger single tap Redo

name: Finger stationary hold eyedropper

name: Pen draw then hold shape recognition

name: Two-finger pan/zoom
description: Current basic navigation with gesture arbitration.

name: Two-finger twist rotate view
description: Planned G02 capability; not yet verified.
